sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profile" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (id = 'local_user'), "display_name" TEXT NULL, "birth_year_or_age" INTEGER NULL, "sex_for_formula" TEXT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "activity_level" TEXT NULL, "goal_type" TEXT NULL, "goal_adjustment_kcal" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "api_key_metadata" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "secure_ref" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "masked_suffix" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority_order" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "health_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "cooldown_until" INTEGER NULL, "last_success_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_failure_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error_category" TEXT NULL, "success_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "failure_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (id = 1), "onboarding_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("onboarding_completed" IN (0, 1)), "weight_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "height_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "theme_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "locale" TEXT NOT NULL, "active_key_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES api_key_metadata (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "gemini_model" TEXT NOT NULL, "preview_before_save" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("preview_before_save" IN (0, 1)), "voice_disclosure_acknowledged" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("voice_disclosure_acknowledged" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_targets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_from_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "calorie_target" INTEGER NOT NULL, "protein_target_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_target_g" REAL NULL, "fat_target_g" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "formula_snapshot_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_request_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "consumed_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "timezone_offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "meal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_user_text" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "total_calories_kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "total_protein_g" REAL NULL, "total_carbs_g" REAL NULL, "total_fat_g" REAL NULL, "ai_model" TEXT NULL, "ai_key_metadata_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES api_key_metadata (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_log_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES food_logs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NULL, "quantity" REAL NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "portion_text" TEXT NULL, "calories_kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fiber_g" REAL NULL, "sodium_mg" REAL NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL, "assumption_note" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_log_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES food_logs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "local_request_id" TEXT NULL, "error_category" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "api_key_usage_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "api_key_metadata_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES api_key_metadata (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "local_request_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_category" TEXT NULL, "http_status" INTEGER NULL, "latency_ms" INTEGER NULL, "prompt_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "output_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "model_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorite_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "use_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_used_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminder_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (id = 1), "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "reminder_time_local" TEXT NOT NULL, "threshold_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active_weekdays_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quiet_hours_start" TEXT NULL, "quiet_hours_end" TEXT NULL, "permission_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notification_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform_notification_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "scheduled_for" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "opened_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "financial_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("type", "name"), CHECK (type IN ('expense', 'income')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "financial_periods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cycle_start_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "budget_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("start_date", "end_date"), CHECK (cycle_start_day BETWEEN 1 AND 28), CHECK (budget_amount >= 0), CHECK (end_date >= start_date));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "financial_transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IDR', "transaction_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES financial_categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_reimburse" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_reimburse" IN (0, 1)), "financial_period_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES financial_periods (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (type IN ('expense', 'income')), CHECK (amount > 0), CHECK (currency_code = 'IDR'), CHECK (type = 'expense' OR is_reimburse = 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "finance_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (id = 1), "cycle_start_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 25, "default_budget_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IDR', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (cycle_start_day BETWEEN 1 AND 28), CHECK (default_budget_amount >= 0), CHECK (currency_code = 'IDR'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_drafts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "text" TEXT NOT NULL, "selected_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (selected_mode IN ('automatic', 'nutrition', 'expense', 'income', 'schedule')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "start_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "end_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "due_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "local_start_date" TEXT NULL, "local_start_time" TEXT NULL, "local_end_time" TEXT NULL, "due_date_local" TEXT NULL, "all_day" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("all_day" IN (0, 1)), "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES schedule_categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "recurrence_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "recurrence_interval" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "recurrence_weekdays_json" TEXT NULL, "recurrence_end_date_local" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "original_user_text" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (item_type IN ('event', 'task')), CHECK (priority IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')), CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'completed', 'cancelled')), CHECK (recurrence_type IN ('none', 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly')), CHECK (recurrence_interval >= 1), CHECK ((item_type = 'event' AND (all_day = 1 OR start_at_utc IS NOT NULL)) OR item_type = 'task'), CHECK (end_at_utc IS NULL OR start_at_utc IS NULL OR end_at_utc > start_at_utc));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "schedule_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES schedule_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_notification_occurrences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reminder_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES schedule_reminders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "schedule_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES schedule_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurrence_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform_notification_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "scheduled_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("reminder_id", "occurrence_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduler_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (id = 1), "default_event_duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 60, "default_reminder_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 15, "default_task_reminder_time" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '09:00', "week_starts_on" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monday', "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Jakarta', "rolling_horizon_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_daily_targets_effective ON daily_targets (effective_from_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_food_logs_local_date_deleted_status ON food_logs (local_date, deleted_at, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_food_logs_consumed_at ON food_logs (consumed_at_utc)
CREATE INDEX idx_food_items_log_sort ON food_items (food_log_id, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_food_items_normalized_name ON food_items (normalized_name)
CREATE INDEX idx_chat_sessions_local_date ON chat_sessions (local_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_chat_messages_session_created ON chat_messages (session_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_chat_messages_local_request ON chat_messages (local_request_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_api_keys_selection ON api_key_metadata (is_enabled, priority_order, health_status, cooldown_until)
CREATE INDEX idx_api_usage_key_created ON api_key_usage_events (api_key_metadata_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_api_usage_request ON api_key_usage_events (local_request_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_favorites_name ON favorite_templates (name)
CREATE INDEX idx_notification_local_date_status ON notification_events (local_date, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_financial_categories_type_active ON financial_categories (type, is_active)
CREATE INDEX idx_financial_periods_dates ON financial_periods (start_date, end_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_financial_transactions_period_type_date ON financial_transactions (financial_period_id, type, transaction_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_financial_transactions_category ON financial_transactions (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_financial_transactions_period_reimburse ON financial_transactions (financial_period_id, is_reimburse)
CREATE INDEX idx_chat_drafts_updated ON chat_drafts (updated_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_schedule_categories_active ON schedule_categories (is_active, name)
CREATE INDEX idx_schedule_items_time_status ON schedule_items (status, start_at_utc, end_at_utc)
CREATE INDEX idx_schedule_items_due_status ON schedule_items (status, due_date_local, due_at_utc)
CREATE INDEX idx_schedule_items_category ON schedule_items (category_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_schedule_reminders_item_enabled ON schedule_reminders (schedule_item_id, is_enabled)
CREATE INDEX idx_schedule_occurrences_item_time ON schedule_notification_occurrences (schedule_item_id, scheduled_at_utc)
CREATE INDEX idx_schedule_occurrences_sync ON schedule_notification_occurrences (sync_status, scheduled_at_utc)
